nodes.name: When Called by WF1
nodes.notes:
Input from WF1 agent branch:
{ agent_id, agent_name, agent_phone, text, messageId }

parameters.query: SELECT followup_id, conversation_id, lead_name, prompt_kind, current_stage, is_correction FROM get_active_followup($1);

-- Advance stage (only if the LLM returned a valid stage), mark the followup answered, log the inbound reply.
-- NOTE: the function-call CTEs MUST be referenced by the final INSERT...SELECT (FROM ans LEFT JOIN upd),
-- otherwise Postgres prunes the unreferenced SELECT CTEs and the side effects never run.
WITH upd AS (
  SELECT update_lead_stage($1::uuid, $5, $2, $6, $7, NULLIF($8,'')::timestamptz) AS r
  WHERE $5 IS NOT NULL AND $5 <> ''
),
ans AS (
  SELECT answer_followup($3::bigint, $4, NULLIF($5,'')) AS v
)
INSERT INTO messages (conversation_id, direction, sender_type, body, metadata)
SELECT $1::uuid, 'inbound', 'agent', $4,
       jsonb_build_object('purpose','followup_reply','followup_id',$3,'parsed_stage',$5)
FROM ans LEFT JOIN upd ON true
RETURNING conversation_id;
